other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in Classes 1 to 8
Eligibility is not affected by a one‑year failure in studies
Re‑application is not required for renewal of the scholarship
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹250 per year for classes 1‑5 and ₹200 per year for boys or ₹600 per year for girls in classes 6‑8, paid directly into the student's bank account.
